Naples Velo Saturday Ft. Myers Bridge Ride

Naples, FL · North Naples · Road

Naples Velo Saturday Ft. Myers Bridge Ride is a road group ride in Naples, FL. It rolls every Saturday at 7:00 am from Naples Cyclery (side lot). About 45 miles, black group 30+ mph in places; Blue group 24–27 mph; rotating paceline.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 24–27 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @naples.velo the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Naples Velo Saturday Ft. Myers Bridge Ride group ride

A fast 45-mile paceline ride to the Fort Myers Beach bridge and back. Two groups leave a few minutes apart and regroup near the bridge. Not a beginner ride. The club also runs slower Green coffee rides (18–22 mph) from the same lot.
